svg.title: Compact fixed-case qualitative comparison
svg.desc: Publication-layout derivative preserving every frozen qualitative image panel and moving row labels into a dedicated left gutter.
svg.text: Each fixed GT-selected case uses one full-image row and one identically cropped GT-defined ROI row.
Tumour colours: NCR/NET gold, oedema cyan, enhancing tumour magenta.
Public labels are fixed GT-burden percentiles; no subject identifiers or performance-driven case selection.
